title: Snorlax Keeps Eating While Asleep
premise: Snorlax can start nodding off during a meal, then keep eating while asleep.
audiencePromise: See how Snorlax turns falling asleep into part of its eating routine.
openLoop: How can Snorlax keep eating after sleep takes over?
payoff: Its strange rule is simple: sleep does not stop the meal.
engagementQuestion: Impressive eating skill, or the strangest sleep habit?

voice.instructions: Warm, quick, and playful. Stress the words asleep, keeps eating, and 900 pounds. Pause briefly before each reveal. Sound amazed, not like a documentary narrator.

scenes.headline: ASLEEP. STILL EATING.
scenes.narration: Snorlax falls asleep eating—and keeps eating.
scenes.caption: ASLEEP. STILL EATING.

scenes.headline: 900 POUNDS A DAY
scenes.narration: Its Pokédex says it eats nearly 900 pounds every day.
scenes.caption: NEARLY 900 POUNDS DAILY

scenes.headline: THE MEAL DOESN'T STOP
scenes.narration: Then it starts nodding off, without stopping the meal.
scenes.caption: NODDING OFF MID-MEAL

scenes.headline: SLEEP KEEPS DINNER MOVING
scenes.narration: Sleep should end dinner. For Snorlax, sleep keeps dinner moving.
scenes.caption: SLEEP DOESN'T END THE MEAL

scenes.headline: EATING ON AUTOPILOT
scenes.narration: So the food counter climbs while Snorlax remains asleep.
scenes.caption: 900 POUNDS. EYES CLOSED.

scenes.headline: SKILL OR SLEEP HABIT?
scenes.narration: Impressive eating skill, or the strangest sleep habit?
scenes.caption: SKILL OR STRANGEST SLEEP HABIT?
